records.title: Brandeis University Wien International Scholarship

records.title: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
records.official_source: National University of Singapore, Office of Admissions
records.deadline_display: The official 'Important Dates and Application' page lists the Application Period for the NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship as "Based on admissions application timeline." The NUS admissions 'Important Dates' page shows the AY2027/2028 application windows as "16 December 2026 to 4 January 2027 [Closed]" (NUS High School Diploma), "16 December 2026 to 3 February 2027 [Closed]" (Polytechnic Diploma from Singapore), "16 December 2026 to 17 February 2027 [Closed]" (IB Diploma) and "18 February 2027 (Late Afternoon) to 19 March 2027 [Closed]" (Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level), with "Application Form: CLOSED".
records.application_period: Considered automatically through the NUS undergraduate admissions application; selection interviews are conducted from January to July and interviewed candidates are informed of scholarship outcomes by mid-July. For AY2027/2028 the NUS admissions application form is currently shown as CLOSED, so the next cycle has not yet opened as at 2026-10-04.

records.title: LUT Scholarship and Early Bird Discount (master's studies)
records.deadline_display: No scholarship application deadline exists: the awards are automatic. The early bird discount requires that you 'accept your study place and pay the remaining first-year tuition fee of EUR 10,000 within 21 days of your official admission email'. The LUT scholarship requires 60 ECTS recorded on your Transcript of Records by 31 July. LUT's own homepage states applications to English-language master's programmes are open until 31 March 2027 under rolling admission.

records.title: Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship
records.deadline_display: No single closing date: 'This scholarship is for all areas of study and is reviewed monthly. The above closing date does not apply.' Applications must be received by 30 November for A trimester offers of place, 31 May for B trimester, 31 August for C trimester, and 31 October for H or X trimester.
records.application_period: Continuous, with monthly review. Cut-offs by offer of place: 30 November (A trimester), 31 May (B trimester), 31 August (C trimester), 31 October (H or X trimester).
